reason: I'm short two waiters, so guests paying from the table does sound useful, but I'm not putting a QR code on my tables that invites people to rate every dish publicly. One bad day in my kitchen and it sits there forever, and 59 lari plus a payment fee on top is real money for me once the free months end.
objection: Dish ratings that are public and permanent. When I'm understaffed, one slow night or one burnt pastry gets rated and I can't do anything about it.
would_change_my_mind: If I could keep dish ratings private, so only I see them, and just use it for table payment and loyalty, I'd try the free 3 months.
